phase: Phase F2d - combined real range + Doppler LRO orbit determination (N = 200)
data: 2009-260, PAD 103 / 105 / 126: F1's 2 473 two-way ranges and F1c's 2 416 Doppler intervals
model: F2c's (GL1800F N=200, MOON_PA_DE440, Earth/Sun point masses DE440, cannonball SRP with shadow events, PropagationProfile, rtol 1e-10) and F1/F1c's measurement models (range with group media delay; Doppler = counted_doppler with phase media delay at the record's f_t)
solve_for: initial state (6), K_SRP, range bias per station (3), one global Doppler bias [m/s] (F1c: the same -11.1 mm/s at all stations and on two days)
weights: range sigma 1 m, Doppler sigma 2 mm/s (F1c post-offset scatter 1-3 mm/s)
priors: F2b's: station range biases N(F1 per-station mean, 3 m), K_SRP N(0.010, 0.005); Doppler bias no prior
starts: LOLA epoch state +-(1 km, 1 m/s) as in F2
partials: A1 FD sensitivities; Doppler partials from counted_doppler(with_partial=True); Doppler-bias partial 1
termination: F2's (relative cost change < 1e-8 with position step < 1 mm, or 30 iterations); in addition a run is STATIONARY when the damping limit is reached after an accepted iteration whose relative cost change was < 1e-6 (F2/F2c ended stationary but labelled DampingLimit)

gates.G1_convergence: both starts end Converged or STATIONARY
gates.G2_start_independence: the two solutions agree to <= 1 m in position over the arc
gates.G3_postfit: post-fit range RMS <= 2 m and Doppler RMS <= 5 mm/s for both starts

reported_not_gated: position difference to the LOLA SPK (R/A/C RMS and max, total); expectation: along-track and cross-track improve from F2c's ~90 m; K_SRP, biases, Doppler bias vs F1c's -11.1 mm/s
